import numpy as np
def equation(t, A, params):
    p = params
    base = -(p[0] + p[1]*t**p[2] + p[3]*np.exp(-p[4]*t))
    amp = p[5] + p[6]*t + p[9]*t**2
    hill = A**p[7]/(p[8]**p[7] + A**p[7])
    return base + amp*hill
